=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:661-674 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In check_one(), the truncated-runs branch nulls `fresh`/`run` once the window passes, so decide() returns `unverified`. unverified_comment() (lines 374-380 per minimax; 394-399 per gpt-6-luna; 394-401 per glm) then says "no run of `<workflow>` within N h", even though the cut-off page may have held real completed runs that could not be graded.
  WHY: The comment overstates the absence of runs and can mislead operators or downstream automation into escalating or re-merging. All four flagging reviewers rated it NIT and agree the label, lifecycle, journal and outcome are correct. minimax notes the pre-existing not_contained branch shows the same wording issue. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to report it because the plan prescribes this exact text (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 467). minimax's hardening suggestion is to change the text to "no gradable run of `<workflow>` within {window_h} h" (1 line).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for" (register scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py in the ref-audit test)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test suite fails because scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py is not registered in the ref-audit test. The failure list on PR head 4e34fcd names tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py as a regression. Neither the LAST RUN DIFF nor pr_changed_files.txt modifies that test. The audit trips on the new fetch_from_ref_or_local loop in issue_pr_status.yml:167-176 and orchestrate_poll.yml:625. Both flagging reviewers rated it BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected the gap: the test has no script registry, it classifies checkout@v5 workflows via ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS (lines 28-67), issue_pr_status.yml is already allowlisted at line 33, and the PR adds no new workflow.
- requirement: "Post-merge check: 1 + 6 × MAX_PER_TICK" API calls, with runs obtained from `_load_actions_runs_cached` at zero additional calls; arm is limited to one read and at most three writes per merged PR
  expected_change_site: scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py check_one() and cmd_arm(); API-budget assertions in tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: check_one() issues an extra per-candidate workflow-runs request (lines 651–655) when the cache lacks a merge-commit run. The runs cache in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19547-19551 keeps only the 20 newest completed runs repo-wide. The tests allow `1 + 8 × MAX_PER_TICK` (tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py:331–335, line 332). cmd_arm() can perform four writes when the label retry succeeds: two label POSTs (lines 478-481 per minimax; 533–542 per gpt-6-luna), plus the marker comment (lines 484-487), plus the journal append (line 490). Severities: MAJOR (gemini, gpt-6-luna), NIT (minimax). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash did not report it as a gap because it is a deliberate deviation, documented in the agents.d "API budget" bullet and the module docstring and accepted in a previous round.
- requirement: "A recorded release-gate payload with P5's marker shows `recurred` for runs 40876853022 / 40932430968 and `held` for a later green run."
  expected_change_site: tests/fixtures/persist/postmerge_release_gate_runs.json and tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py:test_replay_release_gate_fixture
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The fixture identifies itself as synthetic (tests/fixtures/persist/postmerge_release_gate_runs.json:2 `_comment`, and the agents.d "Plan conflicts" bullet). The recorded payloads for runs 40876853022 and 40932430968 are not in the repository, so the replay test checks synthetic data. All flagging reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash did not report it: the deviation is self-disclosed, it cannot be fixed inside the PR, and the prior editor recorded TASK_GAP_DEFERRED.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:672-673 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the workflow-runs read is cut off (total_count > len(page)) and the page has no merge-commit run, `run`/`fresh` are set to `None` and decide() returns `unverified` once the window passes.
  WHY: The comment says "no run of `<workflow>` within N h" even when runs did exist but could not be graded because of truncation, which misleads the operator. The label lifecycle and unverified state are correct.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for (specifically, registering `scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py` in the ref-audit test).
  Expected change site: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py
  Evidence of absence: The test suite fails because the newly added `scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py` is not registered in the ref-audit test; the failure list explicitly confirms this test is failing due to the change.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Post-merge check: 1 + 6 × MAX_PER_TICK" API calls, with runs obtained from `_load_actions_runs_cached` at zero additional calls; arm is limited to one read and at most three writes.
  Expected change site: scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py, cmd_arm() and check_one(); API-budget assertions in tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py.
  Evidence of absence: `check_one()` issues an additional workflow-runs API request when the cache does not contain a merge-commit run (lines 651–655), and the tests explicitly allow `1 + 8 × MAX_PER_TICK` calls (line 332). `cmd_arm()` performs two label-write attempts, posts a marker, and journals it, exceeding the plan's three-write limit when the first label attempt fails but the retry succeeds.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "A recorded release-gate payload with P5's marker shows `recurred` for runs 40876853022 / 40932430968 and `held` for a later green run."
  Expected change site: tests/fixtures/persist/postmerge_release_gate_runs.json and tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py.
  Evidence of absence: The fixture identifies itself as synthetic and states the recorded payloads are not included. The replay test validates synthetic data rather than the recorded payload the plan requires.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

The pre-existing not_contained branch reaches the same wording once the window expires.
  WHY: An operator or downstream automation sees a definitive "no run" message when a completed run existed but could not be graded because of pagination, and could escalate or re-merge on that false reading.
